dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Kate, would you mind checking my email before I send it?
dialogue.reading: ˈkeɪt, wʊd juː ˈmaɪnd ˈtʃɛkɪŋ maɪ ˈiːmeɪl bɪˈfɔːr aɪ ˈsɛnd ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Not at all. What's the subject line?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ət ˈɔːl. ˈwʌts ðə ˈsʌbdʒɪkt ˌlaɪn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: "Hotel rooms in June." Is that OK?
dialogue.reading: hoʊˈtɛl ˈruːmz ɪn ˈdʒuːn. ɪz ðæt oʊˈkeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, it's short and clear. How does the email start?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ɪts ˈʃɔːrt ənd ˈklɪr. ˈhaʊ dʌz ði ˈiːmeɪl ˈstɑːrt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: "Dear Ms. Clark, I'm writing to book twenty rooms for our tour group."
dialogue.reading: ˈdɪr ˈmɪz ˈklɑːrk, aɪm ˈraɪtɪŋ tə ˈbʊk ˈtwɛnti ˈruːmz fər aʊr ˈtʊr ˌɡruːp.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Good. Did you add the list of names as an attachment?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd. dɪd juː ˈæd ðə ˈlɪst əv ˈneɪmz əz ən əˈtætʃmənt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I did. How should I end the email?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈdɪd. ˈhaʊ ʃʊd aɪ ˈɛnd ði ˈiːmeɪl?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Write "I look forward to hearing from you" and then "Best regards."
dialogue.reading: ˈraɪt aɪ ˈlʊk ˈfɔːrwərd tə ˈhɪrɪŋ frəm juː ənd ˈðɛn ˈbɛst rɪˈɡɑːrdz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great. Thank you, Kate! I'll send it now.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt. ˈθæŋk juː, ˈkeɪt! aɪl ˈsɛnd ɪt ˈnaʊ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK. Check your inbox this afternoon. She usually replies quickly.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ˈtʃɛk jʊr ˈɪnbɑːks ðɪs ˌæftərˈnuːn. ʃiː ˈjuːʒuəli rɪˈplaɪz ˈkwɪkli.
